#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    
    int l = 0, r = 0;
    int ans = 0;
    int n = input.length();
    
    while (l < n) {
        r = l;
        while (r < n && input[r] == input[l]) {
            r++;
        }
        if ((r - l) % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        l = r;
    }
    
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
